verdict.rationale: ReelMimic's evidence for bulk operations is thin. It lets you queue many timestamped review notes on a video and submit them in one batch. Its post-video command can also target several platforms (tiktok, instagram, youtube) in one invocation. Missing for 10: bulk actions across many projects or videos (e.g. batch generation, batch export or batch posting of multiple projects), any bulk-operation docs beyond these two narrow cases, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
